# Support

Thanks for using AgentClaw (agent-swarm-monitor)! Here's how to get help.

## Reporting Bugs

If you've found a bug, please [open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/AINative-Studio/agent-swarm-monitor/issues/new).
Include:

- What you expected to happen vs. what actually happened
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Your environment (OS, Node version, browser)
- Any relevant logs or screenshots

## Requesting Features

Feature requests are also welcome via
[GitHub issues](https://github.com/AINative-Studio/agent-swarm-monitor/issues/new).
Please describe the use case and why the feature would be valuable.

## Documentation

Start with the [README](https://github.com/AINative-Studio/agent-swarm-monitor#readme) for an overview of the project, setup
instructions, and architecture. The `docs/` directory contains additional
implementation notes.

## Asking Questions

For general questions about using or contributing to this project, please
open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/AINative-Studio/agent-swarm-monitor/issues)
with the `question` label. This keeps support requests visible and
searchable for other users who may run into the same issue.

## Contact

For anything that shouldn't be discussed in a public issue (e.g. security
concerns), you can reach the maintainers at **support@ainative.studio**.

For security vulnerabilities specifically, please avoid filing a public issue
and instead contact us directly at the address above so we can address the
report responsibly.
